 Even though happiness may be on its way, don't let it affect your work right now. 
 This is the bull's thought and your fortune.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
即使幸福已經在路上，也別讓它耽誤了眼前的工作。
這就是牛的想法，也是給你的預言。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Speaking of the future is as dangerous act. 
 Humans may face disaster if speaking of the future carelessly. That's why we ask cards about the future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
談論未來，是件危險的事。
人若隨意談論未來，可能會招來災禍。
所以，我們才藉助卡牌詢問未來。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Your fortune is a rather good one. There are some in this world who get more horrible fortunes. 
 Use this fortune as a support in your life. Ok?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你的預言已經算不錯了。
這世上，有人得到的預言可怕得多。
把這份預言當作生活中的支援吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Someone that knows of the dangers you do not, will warn you in the form of cards... so listen carefully-!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
有人知道你尚不知曉的危險，會借卡牌提醒你...
所以，要仔細聽！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Do you see the forbidden mark on its shoulder? It is telling you to not do something.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
看見它肩膀上的禁止符號了嗎？
它是在提醒你，有件事不能做。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Someone is after you. The person is very strong like the picture. They might be holding grudges against you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
有人盯上你了。
那個人像牌上畫的一樣強壯，可能對你懷恨在心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The sound of a moth's wings fluttering means chaos. A chaotic event may occur around you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
飛蛾振翅的聲音，意味著混亂。
你身邊可能會發生一場亂子。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Be aware of the wings. Wings symbolize flight, adventure, and fickleness of a player.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
留意翅膀。
它象徵著飛翔、冒險，以及花心之人的善變。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you see the flag of a pirate, either run or do as they say. Pirates do not give more than one warning.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
看見海盜旗，要麼逃跑，要麼聽他們的話。
海盜不會警告第二次。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Pirates give warnings about many things. But right now, this card is speaking of betrayal.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
海盜會對許多事情發出警告。
可眼下，這張牌說的是背叛。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marina doesn't really think about anything else.. But it will say one thing. Food. The Marina loves food.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
水母不怎麼想別的事...
不過，它會提起一件事：食物。
它最愛吃了。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette is warning about ominous activities. If you did something recently, you should settle it soon.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃在警告某些不祥的舉動。
你最近若做過什麼，最好儘快處理妥當。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette's eyes are warning about your falsehood. Lies, deceit, fake calculations and actions.. The Marionette is warning about all of them.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃的眼睛，在警告你別弄虛作假。
謊言、欺騙、虛假的盤算和行動...這些，它都在警告。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette is emphasizing a proper diet. Don't rely too much on meat.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃強調，飲食要合理。
別光顧著吃肉。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa punishes those who challenge it without warning. Unexpected punishment.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙會毫無預警地懲罰挑戰它的人。
懲罰來得突如其來。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa is warning you to be nice to others, or else it will turn you into stone.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙警告你，要善待別人，否則就把你變成石頭。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa is warning you to return anything you borrow on time. 
 Saying it will not forgive those who use other's things like a black hole.. borrowing and never returning
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙提醒你，借了東西要按時歸還。
那些像黑洞一樣，把別人的東西借去就不還的人...它可不會原諒。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa is warning about a person near you. Of their existence.. and the relationship,
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙提醒你，留意身邊的某個人。
那個人的存在...以及你們之間的關係。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Baphomet says to beware when intervening with others' issues.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴風特說，插手別人的事，要多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Baphomet is warning about arrogance. Even a strong and wise warrior must show respect to a Baphomet, 
 Arrogance takes away that respect. The Baphomet hates that type of arrogance.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴風特在警告你，別傲慢。
再強大、再聰明的戰士，也得對它心懷敬意。
傲慢會讓人失去敬意，而它最討厭這種傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Baphomet is warning about the laziness that stops one from sharpening the scythe. 
 That laziness will cause you to lose your life in an instant.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴風特警告你，別懶得磨鐮刀。
這樣的懶惰，會讓你轉眼間丟了命。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Sand is an instant cure of athlete's foot. He says to beware of athlete's foot and that he hates those rubbing their infected feet into his body.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
沙子能立刻治好腳氣。
它提醒你當心腳氣，也討厭別人把感染的腳蹭在它身上。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A chicken puts sand in its mouth to aid its insufficient digestion system. 
 The Sandman says to watch out before you become like a chicken.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
雞會吃些沙子，彌補消化能力的不足。
泥人提醒你，多加小心，別弄得和雞一樣。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Sandman says over-sleepers will be punished by society!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
泥人說，貪睡的人會受到社會的懲罰！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 One warning from the Sandman, respect your parents.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
泥人有句忠告：尊重父母。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Sohee dislikes stinky feet. Don't forget to wash your feet.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
鬼女討厭臭腳。別忘了洗腳。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Sohee stands on the tip of her toes. It is because her toes are very strong. 
 No matter what a person does, physical strength is the most important. Exercise and get stronger.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
鬼女踮著腳尖站立，因為她的腳趾很有力。
不管做什麼，體力都是最重要的。
鍛鍊身體，讓自己更強壯吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Look at Sohee's hairstyle. Isn't it splendid. 
 Sohee likes to take care of her appearance. If you don't, Sohee will get mad at you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
看看鬼女的髮型，是不是很漂亮？
她喜歡打理自己的外表。
你要是不注意儀容，她可是會生氣的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Once, Sohee didn't get her change back when she asked a baby ghost to run an errand. 
 No can do! Always return the change.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
有一次，鬼女讓小鬼跑腿，結果小鬼沒把零錢還給她。
這可不行！
剩下的零錢，一定要還。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Even though it is a skeleton with only bones, it has all the safety gear needed.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
雖然它只是副骨架，安全裝備卻一樣不少。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The skeleton card has a gray tone. If you read the grey, you can see the darkness. 
 It seems like darkness is on its way. Be careful, this darkness isn't ordinary.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
邪骸戰士牌是灰色調的。
細看那片灰色，就能看見黑暗。
黑暗似乎正在逼近。
小心，這不是尋常的黑暗。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The skeleton is warning you about an irregular eating pattern. 
 It says it became like that because of a bad eating habit.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
邪骸戰士提醒你，別吃得沒規律。
它說，自己就是飲食習慣不好，才變成這樣的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The skeleton's pickaxe is very strong. Even though its body seems weak, with the right tools, it can do great things.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
邪骸戰士的鎬頭很厲害。
身子看著雖弱，有了合適的工具，也能做成大事。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The knight is warning you of cruelty. It could be yours or that of someone around you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
騎士提醒你，當心殘忍。
可能是你自己的，也可能來自身邊的人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The misfortune shown in the knight card is hastiness. That is also what takes away a knight's life, too.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
騎士牌所警示的，是急躁。
這也會奪走騎士的性命。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This knight is warning you of loneliness. He doesn't have a person to help his horse, 
 nor a lover awaiting him, so loneliness hits him in the heart.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
這位騎士提醒你，當心孤獨。
沒人替他照料馬匹，也沒有愛人等他歸來，孤獨便刺進了他的心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The warning of the god of death is death itself.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
死神發出的警告就是死亡本身。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Anubis says to be careful of darkness. In darkness, death lingers in the dark.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
安畢斯提醒你，小心黑暗。
死亡就潛伏在其中。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Anubis doesn't like foul language. You don't have a foul mouth, do you? 
 Watch your mouth. The Anubis is after those that say foul language.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
安畢斯不喜歡髒話。
你沒有滿口髒話吧？
管好自己的嘴，它會盯上說髒話的人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Anubis is warning you of hatred. Hatred only brings upon death. 
 The Anubis must not like being busy these days.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
安畢斯提醒你，當心仇恨。
仇恨只會帶來死亡。
看來，它最近不想太忙。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord is warning you of self-righteousness. It is the most dangerous noxious bug that will feed on you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
獸人酋長提醒你，別自以為是。
那是最危險的毒蟲，會把你一點點蠶食。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord is warning you about freedom. Isn't freedom a good thing? 
 Not always! Too much freedom can lead to self-indulgence!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
獸人酋長在對自由發出警告。
自由不是好事嗎？
可不總是！過分自由，就會變成放縱！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord warning you of the opposite sex. Yes. They are poisonous. Keep your distance.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
獸人酋長提醒你，當心異性。
沒錯，他們有毒。
保持距離。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord is warning about destruction. He knows destruction very well because he is a master of destruction.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
獸人酋長在警告你，當心毀滅。
它很懂毀滅，因為它就是毀滅的高手。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack is warning you of lame jokes. When he finds one saying them, he tends to hit them with his stick.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傑克提醒你，別講蹩腳的笑話。
碰到這樣的人，它往往會拿棍子打過去。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack is warning you about others' anger and that anger takes away happiness and kills a joke.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傑克提醒你，當心別人的怒氣。
怒氣會奪走快樂，也讓笑話變得不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It seems like Jack is worried about excessive jokes. 
 Jokes are fun, but too much will turn you into a ghost like him.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傑克似乎在擔心，玩笑開得太多。
玩笑雖有趣，開過頭，可會變成和它一樣的幽靈。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jokers enjoy giving opposite warnings. He says to enjoy sleeping in.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡喜歡把警告反著說。
它讓你好好享受睡懶覺。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jokers enjoy giving opposite warnings. He says to enjoy a midnight snack.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡喜歡把警告反著說。
它讓你好好享受夜宵。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jokers enjoy giving opposite warnings. 
 He says if someone has something you want, make it yours.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡喜歡把警告反著說。
它說，別人有你想要的東西，就佔為己有。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Joker enjoys giving opposite warnings. 
 What he is telling you is to not fear death.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡喜歡把警告反著說。
它告訴你，不要怕死。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Hode can forgive others, but not those who hurt it. 
 You should also only not forgive those who hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓可以原諒別人，唯獨不能原諒傷害它的人。
你也一樣，只對傷害過你的人不必原諒。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Hode is warning you of voracious eating that made it sluggish. 
 Eating is good, but the wild is a dangerous place. Leave your stomach partially empty.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓提醒你，別暴飲暴食，它自己就是這麼吃得行動遲緩的。
吃東西雖好，野外卻很危險。
別把肚子塞得太滿。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Hode is warning you of voracious eating that made it sluggish. 
 Eating is good, but the wild is a dangerous place. Leave your stomach partially empty.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓提醒你，別暴飲暴食，它自己就是這麼吃得行動遲緩的。
吃東西雖好，野外卻很危險。
別把肚子塞得太滿。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you are to the point of being warned by a Hode.. you must be one considerable person.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
居然連蚯蚓都要警告你...
你也真是個了不得的人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Bull warns of corruption. A lazy hedonist that is not diligent. 
 He believes that is like a cancer cell that can't be removed.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牛在警告你，當心墮落。
懶惰、不肯努力、只顧享樂的人，在它看來，就像除不掉的癌細胞。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The bull is warning about ignorance about a crisis. 
 Not knowing that a crisis is a crisis is the most dangerous of all.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牛提醒你，別對危機毫無察覺。
身在危機之中，卻不知道有危險，這才是最危險的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The bull is warning of something that will make life sad. 
 Sadness is a natural feeling, but don't let that put you down.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牛在警告你，有些事會讓生活變得悲傷。
悲傷是自然的感受，可別讓它把你壓垮。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The bull is warning about meat from watered cows. 
 Saying that, that type of behavior will surely bring upon monsters' curses.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牛在警告注水牛肉的事。
它說，這樣的行為，一定會招來魔物的詛咒。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is saying to be careful not to burn your mustache with a cigarette. When you do something, something is always at risk.. It is probably warning about that.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它提醒你，抽菸時別燒到鬍子。
做什麼事，總會有些風險...
大概就是在警告這個。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 'Be careful of shoveling'.. You might get hit by a shovel. Should you be careful around a construction site?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
“小心鏟土”...
你可能會被鏟子打中。
是不是該留意工地附近？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The teeth of Dustiness are very strong. This means.. Someone may attempt to bite you with their teeth?!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
獵蠅的牙齒很堅硬。
這意味著...有人可能會咬你？！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The moth's warning: 'Dangerous!'. A very simple, yet obvious warning.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
飛蛾的警告是：“危險！”
簡單，卻再明白不過。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dracula says, 'Be careful in the streets at night.'
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
德古拉說：“晚上在街上要小心。”

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dracula says, 'Don't be too picky.'
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
德古拉說：“不要太挑剔。”

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dracula says, 'Brush your teeth 3 times a day.' Make sure you brush your teeth!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
德古拉說：“每天刷牙3次。”
可別忘了刷牙！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dracula says, 'Study the important points first.' Cramming will not work!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
德古拉說：“先學重點。”
臨時抱佛腳可不行！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The pirate is warning you of your beauty. Don't show off your beauty too much. Pirates are very jealous of appearance, as well.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
海盜對你的美貌發出了警告。
別太炫耀自己的美貌，他們也很嫉妒別人的容貌。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marina is warning of a hot stinging poison. Be cautious of poison.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
水母提醒你，當心灼熱刺痛的毒。
要提防毒素。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marina is warning about a lazy lifestyle. It says such a lifestyle will lead to something like itself.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
水母提醒你，別過懶散的日子。
它說，這麼下去，就會變得和它一樣。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marina is warning about a big belly. It's not happy because it resembles itself.. How about losing some weight?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
水母提醒你，當心大肚子。
它不高興，是因為那模樣太像它自己...
不妨減減肥？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette says that you must not rely on violence and to use a different method. 
 I'm not quite sure, but it may become an important word of advice to you..?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃說，別依賴暴力，要換個辦法。
我也不太確定，不過，這也許會是對你很重要的一句忠告...？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Baphomet says it has nothing to say. I wonder why? Isn't it a very good sign?!!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴風特說，它沒什麼可說的。
為什麼呢？這不正是個好兆頭嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The knight is warning you of reckless driving. Do you ride a Pecopeco by any chance? 
 Anyhow, you should avoid reckless driving.. If a knight is saying that, it is a big problem.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
騎士提醒你，別莽撞地騎行。
你該不會騎著大嘴鳥吧？
總之，別橫衝直撞...
連騎士都這麼說，問題可不小。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you are thinking of something right now, stop your movement. Or else disaster may be headed your way.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你若正盤算著什麼，先停下行動。
否則，災禍可能就要來了。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Look around you. Of course, look for anyone you might have spited..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
看看四周吧。
當然，是看看你可能得罪過的人...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The moth is warning you of this. You should be careful.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
飛蛾正在警告你這一點。
要多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If a word strikes you, be wary of that. Maybe.. a player?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如果哪個詞讓你心裡一動，就要留意它。
也許...是個花心的人？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is the same in life.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
生活中也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 To pirates, betrayal means tragic death. Be careful of betrayals.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
對海盜來說，背叛意味著慘死。
當心背叛。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Eating is happiness. Same goes for humans as well. Value food and enjoy eating.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
吃東西是件幸福的事，人也一樣。
珍惜食物，好好享受吃飯吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A bad result may come your way.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你可能會遇到不好的結果。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This is all for you young one. Therefore, follow this fortune and rid yourself of falsehood.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
年輕人，這些都是為你好。
所以，聽聽這次占卜的指引，改掉弄虛作假的毛病。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Take the Marionette's advice. She never says anything wrong. Hoho...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
聽傀儡娃娃的建議吧，她說的從不會錯。
呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That is a Medusa. You should be careful. The warning ended a long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
這就是米杜沙。
你得小心，警告早就已經結束了。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What a rightful Medusa. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
真是個正直的米杜沙。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Are you sure you returned everything you have borrowed? Better take care of everything before you get punished.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
借過的東西，你確定都還了嗎？
最好趕在受罰之前，把這些事處理好。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa's warning is very stern. Take a close look around you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙的警告很嚴厲。
仔細看看身邊吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 He is very angry about intruding in others' spaces. Accept the Baphomet's warning.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴風特很討厭別人侵入他人的地盤。
聽聽它的警告吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Maybe it means he sees that type of arrogance in you? Since the Baphomet is warning you..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
既然巴風特在警告你...
也許，是它在你身上看到了那種傲慢？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Laziness is more dangerous than the monster in front of you. Don't forget about this warning.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
懶惰比眼前的魔物更危險。別忘了這個警告。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A Sandman's warning is very stern. Wash your feet regularly, young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
泥人的警告很嚴厲。
年輕人，記得勤洗腳。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 And don't eat too much spicy and salty food, alcohol, etc. What a thoughtful Sandman.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
還有，辛辣、過鹹的食物和酒之類的，也別攝入太多。
真是個體貼的泥人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Oooh, a stern warning about the future! Young one, bear this in mind.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
噢，這是對未來的嚴厲警告！
年輕人，記在心裡。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you don't, you will end up like him. Listen to the Sandman.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不然，你就會變成它那樣。
聽泥人的話吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Bah, don't laugh about it! This is a solemn warning.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
哼，別笑！
這可是嚴肅的警告。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you sit around all day, even the things that were going to work won't. Got it? Exercise, exercise!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
整天坐著不動，連原本能成的事，也會做不成。
明白了嗎？運動，運動！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Making yourself look presentable is just as important as keeping a good heart. 
 Take care of your appearance. And get that pepper out from between your teeth!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
把自己收拾得體，和保持善良的心一樣重要。
注意儀容。
還有，把牙縫裡的辣椒弄出來！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 No matter how little the amount, you must not just keep it. Sohee greatly dislikes it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
金額再小，也不能私自留下。
鬼女最討厭這樣。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What the skeleton wants to say is, be aware of 'safety'. Being ignorant about safety is dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
邪骸戰士想說的是，要重視“安全”。
對安全一無所知，可是很危險的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hmm.. would you like an amulet?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
嗯...要不要一個護身符？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Eat the right food at the right time. That's the only way your body will survive. You can't afford to become like a skeleton.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
按時吃飯，也要吃得合適，身體才能撐下去。
可不能把自己弄得像副骷髏。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So don't blame your body right now and go search for the right tools. Then you will have a good result.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以，別隻怪自己身體不行，去找合適的工具吧。
這樣，就會有好結果。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Anyhow, cruelty will harm you for sure. Be cautious of it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
總之，殘忍一定會傷到你。
多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This knight is warning you from the bottom of his heart, 
 so that you don't repeat his mistake. Be ware of hastiness.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
這位騎士是真心在提醒你，別重蹈他的覆轍。
不要急躁。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Loneliness is not simply sadness. It is a formless devil eating your life. Stay away from loneliness.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
孤獨不只是悲傷，而是吞噬生命的無形惡魔。
遠離孤獨。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Be cautious of death.. death that can be your turn, or maybe someone else.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
當心死亡...
可能輪到你，也可能是別人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Take the Anubis's advice and avoid the dark. That is the wisest choice.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
聽安畢斯的忠告，避開黑暗吧。
這才是最明智的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Humans have a problem with their mouths. Mmm~ Agh. Me, too?!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
人總是容易在嘴上出毛病。
嗯~啊，我也一樣？！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Seeing that he is warning about hatred. Don't you think it's a good idea to avoid his eyes at a time like this?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
既然它正在警告仇恨，這種時候，是不是該避開它的目光？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Learn how to accept others' opinions. How about starting from accepting the Orc Lord's?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
學著接受別人的意見吧。
不如先從獸人酋長的意見開始？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 He knows about the danger of freedom as a lord.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
身為領主，它深知自由的危險。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Especially a young one like you... You are too close to one. Cough.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
尤其是你這樣的年輕人...
你和某個異性走得太近了。
咳。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That's why he knows about the danger and misfortune destruction brings. Don't destroy thoughtlessly. You will end up destroying yourself as well.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以，它很清楚，毀滅會帶來怎樣的危險與不幸。
別隨意破壞，否則，連你自己也會被毀掉。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you don't want to be hit, stop your lame jokes!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不想捱打，就別再講蹩腳的笑話了！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Anger only exhausts you. Keep your distance from anger and befriend jokes. Jack's word.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
憤怒只會讓你疲憊不堪。
遠離怒氣，和笑話做朋友吧。
這是傑克的話。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Be careful. When Jack speaks like this, he playfulness is gone.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
要小心。
傑克這麼說的時候，可沒有開玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I think you should wake up early.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
我想，你該早點起床。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't eat anything at night. Your stomach will hurt.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
晚上別吃東西，肚子會疼的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Need I say more? That's a dangerous thought!!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
還用我多說嗎？
那念頭很危險！！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If a Joker is saying this, be careful. There is no cure for thoughtless fools.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡要是這麼說，你可得小心。
不動腦子的傻瓜，沒藥可救。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A small territory will ensure great happiness.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
小小的一片領地，就能帶來大大的幸福。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So you can quickly respond to crises.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
這樣你就能迅速應對危機。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So you can quickly respond to crises.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
這樣你就能迅速應對危機。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It says to do better.. I have no idea what it means.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它說，要做得更好...
我也不知道是什麼意思。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Be careful to not have that kind of cell stuck on you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
小心，別讓那樣的細胞纏上你。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You will need to learn how to read danger. Accept the bull's advice.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你得學會察覺危險。
聽牛的建議吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A bull is an honest worker that cries even while it works. It knows that it must not be lazy about what it needs to do, even when expressing sadness. 
 It seems like he wants to tell you this.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牛是個老實的勞動者，哪怕哭著，也不停幹活。
它知道，即使心裡悲傷，該做的事也不能偷懶。
看來，它想告訴你的，就是這一點。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I don't know why he would warn you about it.. Do you raise cattle by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不知道它為什麼警告你這件事...
你該不會在養牛吧？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A warning is always a useful fortune. You can never lose anything.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
警告總是有用的預言。
聽一聽，你也不會有什麼損失。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I hope you will be able to avoid misfortune with this warning. Then...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
希望這句警告，能幫你避開災禍。
那麼...

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Welcome, welcome~!! {0}~!
 What brings you here today!?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
歡迎，歡迎~！！{0}~！
今天來找我，有什麼事呀？！

scripts.text: I would like a Poring card reading.
scripts.translation: 我想做波利牌占卜

scripts.text: What is a Poring card reading?
scripts.translation: 什麼是波利牌占卜？

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Poring card readings focus on cards with cute Porings..! 
 Poke~poke~ they tell you your fortune! It is not traditional, but the liveliness is the best!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
波利牌占卜，用的都是畫著可愛波利的卡牌...！
戳一戳~戳一戳~它們就會告訴你運勢！
雖然不是傳統占卜，可活潑勁兒絕對最棒！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 The fortunes are simple and refreshing. It is perfect when you would like your fortune told with a light heart and not be burdensome!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
解讀簡單又清爽！
想輕輕鬆鬆佔個卜，不給自己添負擔，選它就對啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Ah~ is that so! 
 Solving the wonders of the future with these cute and adorable Poring cards! 
 It is 1000z for each fortune! Shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
啊~這樣呀！
就用這些可愛的波利牌，解開未來的奧秘吧！
每次占卜1000 Zeny！要開始嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: I would like to think about it once more.
scripts.translation: 我想再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Ok then! Come again next time! We'll do a good job! Bye-bye~!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
好吧！下次再來哦！
我們會好好占卜的！拜拜~！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
You don't even have 1000 zeny!
Nope, I can read cards for you!
Nope!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你連1000 Zeny都沒有！
不行，不能給你占卜！
不行！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Thank you~! Then we shall look into your fortune! 
 First, clear your mind! Just like washing when you wash dishes!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
謝謝~！那就來看看你的運勢吧！
先清空思緒！像洗碗一樣，把腦袋裡的雜念洗乾淨！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Then~ gently think of your wish!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
然後~輕輕地想一想你的願望！

scripts.text: (I'm curious about love!)
scripts.translation: （我想知道愛情運勢！）

scripts.text: (I would like to do well in school!)
scripts.translation: （我想在學校取得好成績！）

scripts.text: (Will my friendship be intact?)
scripts.translation: （我的友誼能長久嗎？）

scripts.text: (I want to know about my future self!)
scripts.translation: （我想知道未來的自己！）

scripts.text: (Will I make a lot of money?)
scripts.translation: （我能賺很多錢嗎？）

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Ohh! Cute love fortune! Heh! Lets look at the cards!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
哦！可愛的愛情運勢！嘿嘿！
來看看卡牌吧！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Oh! Your lover is about to leave your side! Hold on tight!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
哦！戀人就快離開你了！
可要牢牢抓住！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Agh! You're about to give your soul to your loved one! Take it down a notch!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
啊！你都快把靈魂獻給愛人了！
稍微收著點吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 No! Your heart is about to leave your love! Catch it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
不！你的心都快離開愛人了！
快把它抓回來！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Love is like juice in the forest! It is refreshing! Take care of your loved one!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
愛情就像森林裡的果汁，清爽極了！
好好照顧你的愛人吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Uh! You didn't share your juice with your loved one! What a shame! Take care of your loved one!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
啊！你沒把果汁分給愛人！真可惜！
多關心關心對方吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Why not share with your loved one? Don't be too greedy and try to keep it all!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
怎麼不和愛人分享呢？
別太貪心，想把一切都佔為己有！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your love is going to have a crisis! Protect your love!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你的愛情要遇到危機了！
好好守護它吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Hee! Go after your love like a mole! Puhahaha!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
嘿！像鼴鼠一樣追尋愛情吧！
噗哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Oh no! Your love is in danger! Run away from the menace!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
糟糕！你的愛情有危險！
快躲開威脅！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Oh no! You lost your loved one. And, nobody similar around you. Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
糟了！你失去了愛人，身邊也沒有相似的人。
振作起來！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Ah! A sexy rival has appeared! Don't get sidetracked!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
啊！性感的情敵出現了！
別分心！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You are desperately searching for love! If you go beyond this desert, you can find love!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你正拼命尋找愛情！
走出這片沙漠，就能找到啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Prepare an event of love! They will be flying with happiness!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
準備一場浪漫活動吧！
對方會幸福得飛起來！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Love is sweet! Be careful not to get cavities!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
愛情真甜！
小心蛀牙哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Prepare a present for your love! They might get a heart attack because they will be overwhelmed with happiness!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
給愛人準備一份禮物吧！
對方會幸福得受不了，說不定連心臟病都要發作了！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Don't be shy in front of your loved one! Love transcends everything!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
在愛人面前，別害羞！
愛情能超越一切！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Embrace every aspect of your loved one! That is true love!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
接納愛人的每一面！
這才是真愛！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Love will blossom with a totally different person! Wow, so cool!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你會和一個截然不同的人擦出愛情的火花！
哇，真酷！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 No matter what other people say, run towards your loved one! One-track love!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
不管別人怎麼說，都奔向你的愛人吧！
一心一意地愛！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Go to your loved one with a present! They will be very happy!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
帶著禮物去找愛人吧！
對方會很開心！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Love requires health and strength! Exercise to become stronger! Power and love!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
愛情也需要健康和力量！
鍛鍊身體，變得更強壯吧！
力量與愛情！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Even if you wish to approach your loved one, your body is discomforted! Take a break and rest!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你雖想靠近愛人，身體卻不舒服！
歇一歇，好好休息吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Love is bending yourself for someone! Service! Sacrifice!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
愛情就是為對方放下身段！
付出！犧牲！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You will be meeting your lover's parents! Prepare well!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你要見戀人的父母啦！
好好準備！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your relationship must be very happy as it seems you two are flying amongst the clouds! Very jealous!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你們一定很幸福，簡直像在雲端飛翔！
真讓人嫉妒！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Make an opportunity to be alone with each other! It will bring much happiness!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
創造兩人獨處的機會吧！
會很幸福的！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Uh oh! Someone is peeping at your love! Go scold them!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
哎呀！有人在偷看你們談戀愛！
去罵他一頓！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Love blossoms from the foundation! Be true to the basics!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
愛情也要先打好基礎，才能開花！
別忘了最基本的事！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 When your loved one is hurt, be by them! They will be very happy!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
愛人受傷時，就陪在身邊吧！
對方會很開心！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 One day, when you wake up, your loved one will leave a present! Be happy!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
某天醒來，你會發現愛人留下的禮物！
開心吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Give lots~~ of presents to your loved one! Then you will experience many~ many good things!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
給愛人送好多~~禮物吧！
這樣，就會遇到好多~好多好事！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Lean against a wall and await your love! *Boom* Love will appear!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
靠著牆，等愛情來吧！
*砰*愛情就出現啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You must be lonely! It's ok, cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你一定很孤獨吧！沒關係，振作起來！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 A fortune of love was told! What do you think! Do you like it? 
 Even if you did not get the fortune you wished for, don't be do upset and simply go for your love!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
愛情運勢佔完啦！怎麼樣，喜歡嗎？
結果就算不如你所願，也別太難過，勇敢去追求愛情吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Then, see you next time~~~~~
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
那麼，下次再見~~~~~

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Issues about studying is a serious matter! Lets take a look! Yap!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學習可是正經事！
來看看吧！嘿！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Agh! Don't die from studying! Take breaks while you're at it! You need some rest!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
啊！別學習學得連命都沒了！
中途也要歇一歇，你需要休息！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Oh, no! You're missing the main points! Figure out the essentials!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
糟糕！你沒抓住重點！
先弄清最關鍵的內容吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Mmph! You're dying not to study! At times like this, a break is the best!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
唔！你簡直一點兒也不想學了！
這種時候，休息最管用！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Studying is just like hunting a monster in the desert. Resting for a little is the best. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學習就像在沙漠裡打怪，最好中途歇一歇。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 A nice cup of cold juice under the hot sun! Studying should be done like that, too!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
烈日下，喝一杯冰涼的果汁多舒服！
學習時也要這樣調劑一下！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Even though it is the desert, you seem to have a relaxed smile! Maybe you need to relax like this when studying as well!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
明明身在沙漠，卻笑得很輕鬆！
也許學習時，你也該這樣放鬆一下！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your grades are in danger! You must study harder!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你的成績危險啦！
得再努力學才行！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 There may be a big crisis! Don't get too stressed just because you can't study!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
可能會有大危機！
可也別因為學不進去，就給自己太大壓力！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 It is saying studying in the dark night can be dangerous! Careful when studying at night!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
卡牌說，深夜學習可能有危險！
晚上學習要小心哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Studying came to a strange place! It needs to find its original path! You can do it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學習走偏啦！
得找回原來的路！
你能做到！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You're gazing at a smart friend with the eyes of a Poring! Heehee! Doing good!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你正用波利的眼神，望著聰明的朋友！
嘿嘿，做得不錯！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Eh? You're too smart! You're at a much higher level than your friends! Take a break!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
咦？你太聰明了！
水平比朋友們高出一大截！
歇一歇吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You will be rewarded for your accomplishments! It was worth the effort!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你的學習成果會得到獎勵！
努力沒有白費！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Forget about studying for a moment and enjoy the party! It should be refreshing~!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
先把學習放一邊，享受派對吧！
會讓你精神煥發~！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Study something that will make people happy! Future set!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學些能讓人開心的東西吧！
未來就有著落啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 If you're not sure of something, ask a friend! It's not something to be ashamed about! You can do it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
有不明白的，就問朋友！
這沒什麼丟人的！你能做到！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Don't think that your head is empty! Because, you are smart! You can do it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
別覺得自己腦袋空空！
你很聰明，能做到的！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 There's a phenomenon you don't understand! Do a little more research! You'll be able to figure it out soon!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
碰到了不明白的現象！
再研究一下，很快就能弄懂啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Don't get lazy about studying wherever you go! Seek the road of truth and go down it to find the answer!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
不管走到哪裡，學習都別偷懶！
沿著追求真理的路走下去，就能找到答案！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You need strength to study! Get stronger! Running is a start!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學習也得有體力！
讓自己強壯起來，先從跑步開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You will become an admirable person because of all the effort put into studying! You must feel very worth while!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學習上的努力，會讓你成為令人敬佩的人！
你一定覺得這些付出很值得吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Try studying the history of our country! From when the tiger started smoking!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學學我們國家的歷史吧！
就從老虎開始抽菸的年代學起！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You must be having a hard time studying because of all the pressure! Go out and get some fresh air!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
壓力這麼大，你一定學得很辛苦！
出去透透氣吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your head seems to be heavy because of studying! You need a diversion! Put studying aside for a moment!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學習學得腦袋都沉甸甸了！
換換心情，先把學習放一放吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Try studying aerospace or meteorology! Don't you think it would be fun?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
試試學航空航天或氣象學吧！
是不是很有趣？

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 How about studying theology? You even get to study about angels!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
不如學神學？
還能研究天使呢！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Study little by little and make yourself feel lighter! You can't study if you're overloaded with words!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
一點一點學，讓自己輕鬆些！
腦袋裡塞了太多文字，反而學不進去！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 When studying, you should have a snack! It may seem trivial, but it is rather important!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學習時，吃點零食吧！
看著是小事，其實很重要哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Even when you are sick, don't forget about studying! Where there is effort, there is bound to be good results!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
就算生病，也別忘了學習！
有努力，就一定有好結果！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Newton discovered gravity through a falling apple! Be wary of even the little things in your surroundings!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
牛頓從落下的蘋果發現了引力！
身邊的小事，也要留心哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Green is good for studying! Color your walls green or get a green drink! The lucky color! Green!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
綠色有助於學習！
把牆刷成綠色，或者找杯綠色飲料吧！
幸運色！綠色！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 There is a jewel in your mind! You need to bring all the wisdom to life! Don't study bad things!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你的腦袋裡有顆寶石！
把智慧都發揮出來吧，可別學壞！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You will receive good results from studying! You can focus on your current studies!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學習會有好結果！
專心學眼下的內容就好！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You've been told your study fortune! Was it a good one? 
 But in studying, effort is more important than any type of fortune!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
學業運勢佔完啦！結果不錯嗎？
不過，學習這件事，努力比什麼運勢都重要！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Try your best. Then, see you again! Byyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyeeeee~~byyyyeeee~
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
好好加油！那就下次再見啦！
拜~~~~拜~~拜~

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Relationships among friends is more difficult than people think! Let's use the cards to try and solve this complicated puzzle of friendship!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
朋友間的相處，比大家想的還難！
就用卡牌，解開這個複雜的友誼謎題吧！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Ah! Your friend has gone crazy! They need the heal of friendship!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
啊！你的朋友瘋啦！
需要用友誼來治癒！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Mmm! You both have gone crazy. You must overcome it through conversations!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
唔！你們倆都瘋啦！
得好好聊聊，才能解決！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Agh! You are suffering because of your friend! Try opening your heart and be more lenient!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
啊！朋友讓你受苦了！
敞開心扉，試著寬容一些吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You even split a pea between friends! Don't be so cruel. Reflect upon yourself and apologize!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
和朋友連一顆豌豆都要分清！
別這麼狠心，反省一下，去道歉吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Oh no! Your friend is ignoring you! Offer a bottle of juice to your friend! Your friendship may come back?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
糟糕！朋友不理你啦！
送瓶果汁給對方吧，說不定就能恢復友誼？

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Eh!? What kind of friendship is this?! Hurry up and make up!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
咦！？這算哪門子友誼？！
趕快和好吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
Oh no?! This person is not your friend, but an enemy! You must be careful!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
糟了？！這人不是朋友，是敵人！
你得小心！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your friend is in danger! You must help your friend!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
朋友有危險！
快去幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your friendship is on the verge of falling apart! Cast a shield around your friendship!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你們的友誼快破裂啦！
快給它撐起一道護盾！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 One person is left out amongst your friends! Be more friendly!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
朋友裡，有個人被冷落了！
對人家友善些吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your friend hit you! Don't cry even if it may hurt! Hurry and make up!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
朋友打你了！
再疼也別哭，趕快和好吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You must be alone! It must be hard to make friends! Try putting on a brighter face!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你一定是獨自一人，交朋友很難吧！
試著讓表情開朗一些！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Give your friends a present! Your friendship will become deeper!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
給朋友們送份禮物吧！
友誼會更深厚！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Prepare a hat to cover your friend's large head! They will be moved by your care!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
準備一頂帽子，給朋友的大腦袋戴上吧！
這份體貼，會讓對方很感動！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 A friend is waiting for you! Be nice to your friend!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
有朋友正等著你！
對人家好一點哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Being close friends despite differences is true friendship! Shelter each other's differences!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
彼此不同，卻依然親密，這才是真正的友誼！
包容彼此的差異吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your misunderstandings will be removed if you take the time to talk! Go have a conversation with your friend!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
花點時間好好聊，誤會就能解開！
去找朋友談談吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 When a friend is sick, visit them! They will be happy! For sure!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
朋友病了，就去探望！
對方一定很開心！一定！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Go out and have some fun with your friend! Your friendship will surely get stronger!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
和朋友出去玩吧！
你們的友誼一定會更牢固！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Give your friend a present! They'll go bragging around town?!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
給朋友送份禮物吧！
對方說不定會滿鎮子炫耀？！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Share your bone with your friend! Sacrifices in friendship are beautiful!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
把你的骨頭分給朋友吧！
為友誼犧牲，可是很美好的！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Do anything for your friend! With all your heart and soul! Your friend will be delighted!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
為朋友做什麼都行！
全心全意地去做，對方會很開心！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 No smoking, even with a friend! Stop smoking for your health!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
和朋友在一起，也不許抽菸！
為了健康，戒菸吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You and your friend will encounter hardships! Combine your powers and overcome it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你和朋友會遇上困難！
齊心協力，一起克服吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Go on a trip with your friend! Friendship can get stronger in new environments!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
和朋友去旅行吧！
新的環境，能讓友誼更牢固！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Give your friend a ride in a plane! They'll probably fly with joy!?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
讓朋友坐趟飛機吧！
對方說不定會開心得飛起來？！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Don't forget your friend in heaven! Friendship is eternal!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
別忘了天堂裡的朋友！
友誼永恆！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Help your friend's scar. Your friend would greatly appreciate it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
幫朋友撫平傷痕吧！
對方會很感激你！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You even split a slice of an apple among friends! Share more things with your friend! Something good will happen!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
連一片蘋果，你都願意和朋友分！
多和朋友分享些東西吧，會有好事發生！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 When your friend is sleeping, think of them! Then there will be progress in your friendship! What do you think~ it means~?!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
朋友睡著時，也替對方想想吧！
這樣，友誼就能更進一步！
你覺得~這是什麼意思~？！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Don't measure friendship with money! If you do, be careful for there will be a crack in your friendship!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
別用錢衡量友誼！
不然，可要當心友誼出現裂痕！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 It seems as if your friend will give you many presents! Look forward to it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
看來，朋友會送你很多禮物！
期待一下吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You must be lonely without a friend! A good friend will come along soon!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
沒有朋友，你一定很寂寞！
別急，好朋友很快就會出現！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Poring fortunetelling works very well when it is about friendship! 
 It is the heart of the poring card that earnestly hopes for good friendships!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
問友誼，波利牌占卜特別靈！
因為波利牌真心盼著，大家都能擁有美好的友誼！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Did you like it? Next time invite your friend! Then byebye!!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
喜歡嗎？下次把朋友也帶來吧！
那就拜拜啦！！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 If you say fortunetelling! Of course it is about the future! Let's try to figure this out!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
說到占卜，當然少不了未來！
來看看吧！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Oh no! You are not confident about the future! Trust yourself a little more! Hope!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
糟糕！你對未來沒信心！
多相信自己一點，要有希望！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Oh! Do you keep on thinking about your death in the future! First, forget about death and live your life!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
哦！你總想著自己將來會死嗎？！
先忘掉死亡，好好過日子吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Cut! You are filled with uncertainty about the future! Let's get rid of this! Wee! It's gone!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
咔！你對未來滿是不安！
把不安清掉吧！嘿！沒啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Life may seem like a hot and dry desert, but in the future, delicious juice and rest awaits you!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
生活也許像炎熱乾燥的沙漠，可未來有美味的果汁和休息等著你！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Even in a hot and dry desert, isn't the future happier since you can encounter sweet juice? Put forth your strength!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
即使身在炎熱乾燥的沙漠，想著將來能喝到甜甜的果汁，不也很幸福嗎？
加把勁！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Don't your troubles disappear watching a poring smile? Your future must be filled with good things!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
看見波利的笑容，煩惱是不是就散了？
你的未來，一定有很多好事！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 There is danger waiting ahead! You should avoid it for now! Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
前面有危險等著你！
先避開它，好好保護自己！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You must be fearing your future!? Don't worry too much! Think of happy thoughts!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你是不是很害怕未來？！
別太擔心，多想想開心的事！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You may endanger someone in the future! Don't become a bad person~!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你將來可能會危及別人！
可別變成壞人哦~！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You may have to stand alone in the future! Prepare yourself right now!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
將來，你可能得獨自面對一切！
現在就做好準備吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Many hardships await you in the future! But you can overcome them!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
未來有很多困難等著你！
不過，你能克服它們！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You might not even be able to buy summer clothes in the future! Don't waste your money!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
將來，你說不定連夏裝都買不起！
別亂花錢哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Something exciting may happen! What can it be? Fun! Fun!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
可能會發生令人興奮的事！
是什麼呢？好玩！好玩！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Something good might happen on this nice day! You can look forward to it! Yay!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
這麼美好的日子，說不定會有好事發生！
期待一下吧！耶！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 A splendid event will be held! Go get ready! Look forward to it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
會有一場精彩的活動！
快去準備，好好期待吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You will meet someone new! It will be very interesting!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你會認識一個新的人！
會很有趣哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 If you go little by little, something good will happen! Sit and take a look around you!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
一步一步來，就會有好事！
坐下來，看看四周吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You get a headache from thinking about the future? Empty your mind! You will feel refreshed!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
一想未來，就頭疼嗎？
清空思緒，你就會輕鬆多啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You will become a respectable person in the future! Good job!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你將來會成為受人尊敬的人！
真棒！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 I can see you working hard in the future! What a lively future!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
我看見你將來努力工作的模樣了！
真是充滿活力的未來！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You have a very busy future! Take care of your health!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你將來會很忙！
要照顧好身體哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Pick a job where you can work with other people! It will be very rewarding, right?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
選份能和別人一起做的工作吧！
一定會很有成就感，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Try doing some volunteer work! It is worthwhile and you will feel good about it, too!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
試著做些志願服務吧！
既有意義，自己也會很開心！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You may become a commander! Mmm~! Kind of scary!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你可能會成為指揮官！
唔~！有點嚇人呢！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Choose a job that involves flying! You show potential!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
選份和飛行有關的工作吧！
你很有潛力！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Scrumptious ice cream that could even be eaten in heaven! Challenge yourself and get involved in a job making things of that sort!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
美味得連天堂裡都能吃到的冰淇淋！
挑戰一下自己，找份製作這類東西的工作吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 In the future, things that cannot be done right now will be accomplished! You can look forward to it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
現在做不到的事，將來會實現！
好好期待吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Little things in life will bring you happiness and joy in the future! Even more than now!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
生活中的小事，會在將來帶給你幸福和快樂！
比現在還多哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Do what you have to do. Live life to the fullest, even though the world may end tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
做好該做的事！
就算世界明天會毀滅，也要盡情活好今天！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You will deal with fruits in the future! How about preparing yourself?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你將來會和水果打交道！
不妨先做好準備？

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your future self will encounter a high wall! Although, I'm not sure what type of building it may be!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
將來的你，會遇上一堵高牆！
不過，我也不知道是什麼建築的牆！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Green symbolizes peace! Your future seems as if it will be very peaceful! It's a good thing, right?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
綠色象徵著和平！
你的未來看來很安寧！
這是好事，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Romance lays ahead in your future! Relax yourself and prepare yourself!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
浪漫正在未來等著你！
放鬆些，做好準備吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 What do you think? Has your anxiety been relieved after hearing your fortune? 
 This is only a small part of your future! You must discover the rest!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
怎麼樣？聽完運勢，是不是不那麼焦慮了？
這只是未來的一小部分，剩下的要靠你自己去發現！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Am I cheesy? I'm just like that! Then, bye~~~~ye~~~ye~~~~!!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
是不是很肉麻？我就是這樣嘛！
那就拜~~~~拜~~~~！！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Mmm! The long awaited time has come! Asking a question about money to the cute Poring! 
 Ok! Let's try it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
唔！期待已久的時刻到了！
要向可愛的波利問財運啦！
好，來試試！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Uh oh! You're about to be robbed! You must save a little first!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
哎呀！你快被搶啦！
得先存點錢！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Kek! Your mind goes blank when you think about money! Think of other thoughts! Forget about money for a while!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
嘿！你一想到錢，腦袋就空白了！
想點別的，先把錢放一邊吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Bah! This isn't a time to think about money. Calm down and put your mind at ease!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
哼！現在可不是想錢的時候！
冷靜下來，放寬心吧！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 If you look carefully, it is not drinking juice, but underground water through a straw in the ground! Money is hidden where nobody expects! Good luck searching!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
仔細看，它喝的不是果汁，而是用插進地裡的吸管喝地下水！
錢就藏在誰都想不到的地方！
祝你找得順利！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 As you can quench your thirst in the dry desert, you can gather money even in this difficult world!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
乾燥的沙漠裡，也能找到水解渴！
同樣，再艱難的世道，你也能攢下錢！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Just like the juice inside the needles of a cactus, you can still gather wealth though you may be in anguish. You can do it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
就像仙人掌刺裡的汁液，身處痛苦，也能積聚財富！
你能做到！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
Agh! Someone is after your possessions! Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
啊！有人盯上你的財物了！
要小心！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Uh oh! Someone is after your money! Take good care of it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
哎呀！有人打你錢的主意！
可得保管好！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 It says you might be tempted to do something bad to gather money! Don't forget about a kind heart!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
卡牌說，你可能會受誘惑，為了賺錢去做壞事！
別忘了心存善意！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You have hidden money in your clothes! Hidden rich one! Be careful not to be caught!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你把錢藏在衣服裡啦！
原來是個不露富的有錢人！
小心別被發現！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 In the future, it seems like you will be kicking money around with your feet like those Porings! Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
看來，你將來會像那些波利一樣，用腳踢著錢玩！
恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You must be exhausted! Making money is not the easiest thing to do! But it will be that much more valuable!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你一定累壞了！
賺錢不容易，可也正因如此，才更有價值！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Your tendency to spend money is growing! Be careful! Don't be left empty-handed!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你越來越想花錢啦！
小心，別花到兩手空空！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Use your money to buy something fun! Then good luck will be headed your way!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
花錢買些好玩的東西吧！
好運就會來找你！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Use your money on something exciting! It looks as if good luck will be headed your way!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
把錢花在令人興奮的事上吧！
看來，好運要來啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 It seems like you will have two lucky offerings! Don't miss these two opportunities!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你會有兩次幸運的機遇！
兩個都別錯過！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Doesn't it seem like there should be money in the small wallet? You will have some small income! Save money wisely!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
小錢包裡，應該也有錢吧？
你會有一筆小收入！
好好攢錢哦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 So~ empty. Upsetting, but don't worry too much about money! Something better ought to happen!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
好~空啊！真讓人難過！
可也別太為錢發愁，會有更好的事發生！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Someone will return something you lost! What a relief!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
有人會把你丟失的東西還回來！
真讓人鬆口氣！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 No need to worry about osteoporosis! Wasn't it a good thing to eat so much calcium? Oops! This isn't about money?!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
不用擔心骨質疏鬆！
補了那麼多鈣，不是好事嗎？
哎呀！這說的不是錢吧？！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Seeing that you work so hard, seems like you will make lots of money! Congratz~!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
看你工作這麼努力，一定能賺不少錢！
恭喜~！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Even if you save money, it disappears like smoke. Don't get too caught up with it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
錢就算攢下來，也會像煙一樣散掉。
別太執著啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 It's hard to make money, isn't it? But don't forget the good deeds in life!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
賺錢很難，對吧？
不過，也別忘了行善！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Going around to collect money might lead you to a scary person! Be very careful!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
四處奔波收錢，可能會遇到可怕的人！
一定要小心！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Forget about money and fly~fly! You will feel very refreshed!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
忘掉錢，飛~飛起來吧！
心情會很暢快！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Money is like clouds! Instead of money, think about a happy life!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
錢就像浮雲！
與其想著錢，不如想想幸福的生活！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Even if it may seem pointless, if you persist, you will be able to make lots of money! You can do it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
看著也許沒意義，可只要堅持，就能賺很多錢！
你能做到！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Don't neglect the trivial things on the floor! If you keep an open heart like that, you will be able to collect money!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
別忽視地上不起眼的小東西！
保持這份敞開的心，你就能攢下錢！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 If you work with something that is related to mushrooms or apples, a good fortune awaits you! What kind of work would that be?
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
做些和蘑菇或蘋果有關的工作，好運就等著你！
會是什麼工作呢？

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 How can you think of money looking at such a peaceful card! That's not nice! Sniff..sniffles! Anyhow, it seems like you will gather much fortune!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
看著這麼安寧的牌，你怎麼還想著錢！真不乖！
*抽抽鼻子*！
總之，看來你會積攢不少財富！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You have many fine stones! You will prosper if you are involved in this industry!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你有很多漂亮的石頭！
從事這個行業，就能興旺發達！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 It is an indication that you will prosper! No need to worry now!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
這是興旺發達的預兆！
現在不用擔心啦！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 You will collect many treasures! But the problem is protecting all of it!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
你會收集到很多寶物！
不過，難的是把它們都守住！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 There is something you need to keep in mind after being told a fortune about wealth! 
 Money does not automatically come to one without effort! No matter how good the fortune, you must work diligently!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
財運佔完，有件事得記住！
不付出努力，錢可不會自己找上門！
運勢再好，也得勤奮工作！

scripts.text:
[Chocarle]
 Bear that in mind! Then, until we meet again.. *poof*!
scripts.translation:
[巧卡爾]
記住哦！那就下次再見...*噗*！

when I was young and came to the city
and devoted myself to training.
I was in agony because of my slow progress.
scripts.translation:

我從小就決定當占卜師，來到城裡後，便一心投入修煉。
可進步太慢，讓我苦惱極了。

scripts.text:

I came because I heard many 
fortunetellers gather here in Payon,
but nobody will tell me anything~
Waaah~ so sad~
scripts.translation:

聽說斐揚聚集了許多佔卜師，我就來了，可誰也不肯教我~
嗚哇~好傷心~
